rows.name: The Sun And The Moon
steps: Suggested: Show the sun and moon props and say the rhyme once with actions.
Suggested: Say it line by line and let the children repeat each line with the actions.
Suggested: Sing it together with the props, then ask which one we see in the day and which at night.
rows.materials: Sun and moon props (available in school)

levels.0: does not join the group for the rhyme
levels.1: listens to the rhyme and watches the props
levels.2: sings a few lines and does some of the actions with the props
levels.3: sings the whole rhyme with actions and tells which comes in the day and which at night

rows.note: F.N 10 W1 Rhymes P1 (B363), P2 (C365, E364). Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).

rows.name: Introduction to number tracing 5 and 6
steps: Suggested: Show the number 5 and count five objects together.
Suggested: Trace 5 in the air and on the board, then let the children trace it on C.W Pg 29.
Suggested: Do the same for 6, then let the children write each number once on their own.
rows.materials: Maths C.W book (Pg 29), crayons or pencils

levels.0: is not paying attention in the class
levels.1: sits & tries to pay attention while the educator shows the numbers
levels.2: traces 5 and 6 but goes outside the dotted lines
levels.3: traces 5 and 6 neatly on the dotted lines and writes them on own

rows.note: F.N 10 W1 Academic 2 Math, tracing 5 (D364); 6 follows in W2. Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).

rows.name: Trace and write R and D (combination lines)
steps: Suggested: Show R on the board and say which lines make it: a standing line, a curve and a slanting line.
Suggested: Let the children trace R on C.W Pg 53, then write it on their own.
Suggested: Do the same for D with a standing line and a curve.

levels.0: is unwilling to sit for the class
levels.1: concentrates & observes the educator writing R and D
levels.2: traces R and D but the combination lines are not neat
levels.3: traces and writes R and D neatly with the right combination lines

rows.note: F.N 10 W1 Writing - combination lines, Trace and Write R, Pg 53 (B364); D follows in W2. Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).

rows.name: Name of farm animals
steps: Suggested: Show pictures of a cat, dog, cow, horse and goat and say each one's name in Hindi.
Suggested: Point to each picture and let the children say the Hindi name back.
Suggested: Let the children colour the picture on Hindi W.B Pg 15 and say the names of the animals they coloured.

levels.0: is unwilling to sit for the class
levels.1: sits & listens carefully in the class
levels.2: says the Hindi names of a few farm animals
levels.3: says the Hindi names of cat, dog, cow, horse and goat and colours the workbook picture

rows.note: F.N 10 W1 Academic 1 Hindi (E363). Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).

rows.name: Swar ए
steps: Suggested: Say the sound ए and show the letter on the board.
Suggested: Let the children say ए after the educator and name a word that starts with it.
Suggested: Trace ए in the air, then on the page, then let the children write it once on their own.

levels.1: listens and repeats the sound ए after the educator
levels.2: recognises ए but needs help to trace it
levels.3: recognises, says and traces ए on own

rows.note: F.N 10 W2 Hindi (ADR 0109). Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).

rows.name: Memory Drawing
steps: Suggested: Talk with the children about something they all saw, and ask what they remember of it.
Suggested: Give each child a sheet and crayons and let them draw it from memory.
Suggested: Ask each child to show the drawing and say what it shows.

levels.0: is not interested in the activity
levels.1: holds the crayon and draws a little
levels.2: draws one or two things from memory with help
levels.3: draws what was seen from memory with details and says what it shows

rows.note: F.N 10 W1 Monday event (B357) and Extracurricular (B365). Not ACT-K1-1222 (Memory drawing Diwali). Level words awaiting Nimish's OK (ADR 0111).
